reviews.title: Great foundation
reviews.text:
This app is a great start; I love the quick add and prettify functions, and it's good at creating mockups of what an outfit would look like on. I have some suggestions that would make this a Five-star app:

1. Selectable Undertone categories and have a setting so that the app suggests pairings with the same undertones only. This is good for folks who don't have a great color sense in the moment. Same for metals; the metal of clasps & buckles & jewelry should be a separate thing from fabric color and it should suggest consistent metal tones.

2. Tags that can be used to set personal style rules, and when those rules are broken in an outfit there's a little suggestion, e.g. "only one statement piece per outfit" or "always include something blue."

3. A weight tag. When I'm bloated or have put on a few lbs there are items/outfits that don't work anymore; I'd like to be able to hit a button that will make outfit suggestions from among those clothes that are tagged with the heavier end of my weight range. An outfit suggestion with things that work on me at different weights is not helpful. 

4. Customizable colors (e.g. I want to select Sky Blue vs Baby Blue vs Navy Blue, and there are many colors in the current list I don't use and would remove. Perhaps on setup there could be palettes selectable according to a users color season, offering nuanced options in their season and only a few outside their season. 

5. Jewelry sizing: it matters how long a necklace is, make the length an entry field in upload.

This app is an alarming invasion of privacy!

What I discovered, completely unbeknownst to me, is that user profiles and closets are set to PUBLIC by default. This means that anyone who comes across your profile, or simply knows your name and searches for you, can browse your entire virtual closet and see virtually everything you own that you’ve uploaded to the app.

I find this extremely disturbing and unacceptable. I had absolutely no idea that my personal closet was publicly accessible until I accidentally discovered it.

It is incredibly irresponsible of the developers to make users’ private wardrobes public by default. Privacy should be the default setting, and users should have to actively choose to make their profiles public if they wish to share that information.

People should not have to discover by accident that their personal information and belongings are being exposed to strangers. This is a serious privacy issue that needs to be addressed immediately.

reviews.text: Hola, primero quiero felicitarte por crear esta aplicación. 💗 Me gustaría sugerirte tres actualizaciones que creo que mejorarían muchísimo la experiencia de todos los usuarios. La primera sería agregar la opción de tomar o subir fotos de las prendas tanto por delante como por detrás, para que la inteligencia artificial pueda reconocerlas correctamente y reproducir sus diseños sin inventar ni cambiar detalles. La segunda sería permitirnos seleccionar la talla de cada prenda y agregar nuestras medidas corporales, para que la ropa generada se adapte mejor a nuestro cuerpo y podamos ver cómo nos quedaría realmente. Por último, sería genial poder agregar varias fotografías de una misma prenda, incluyendo primeros planos de pequeños detalles como lazos, aberturas, costuras, cierres, bolsillos, forros y diseños especiales, para que la inteligencia artificial pueda identificar cada característica con mayor precisión. Creo que estas tres funciones harían que la aplicación fuera mucho más realista, personalizada y útil, y que nos permitirían obtener resultados mucho mejores sin tener que repetir tantas veces las generaciones. ¡Espero que puedas considerar estas sugerencias para futuras actualizaciones! ❤

reviews.text: I have so many clothes and wear so little of them. This app has changed that for me. It make a huge difference in knowing what to wear that day, what I already have and what I need more of. Could not recommend enough.

reviews.title: What I’ve been waiting for!
reviews.text: This app is AMAZING. So glad I got it. It helps me keep track of all of my clothing and helps me to come up with new outfits that I hadn’t thought of before. I would highly recommend!

reviews.title: Fun and practical!
reviews.text: I found out about the app by searching “virtual wardrobe”after watching Alisha Marie’s virtual wardrobe video on YouTube. I’ve used it for a few weeks now and love it. I love that it’s free and not limiting; I love that I might be able to finally see what I actually wear now vs what I never touch. And I do find myself using it daily to help check what I’ll be wearing the next day or quickly plan an outfit out. I would highly recommend giving this app some love!

reviews.text: i use it because i want to better my outfits and sense of style, it works great!

reviews.title: New Obsession
reviews.text: Absolutely in love with this app. Adding clothing is easy, the outfit suggestions are actually cute, and it helps me remember what I actually have in my closet. I’ve already recommended to my friends. I hope it stays free 💕

reviews.title: Thank you, Alta! 🙂
reviews.text: I'm currently using Alta to catalog all my clothes. I always feel like I have a bunch of clothes and nothing to wear because it's difficult to see everything I have all at once. With Alta, I can easily view all my pieces in the app, which is extremely helpful. It also eliminates the risk of buying duplicates, which is a nice bonus as well. I also love that it suggests new ways to wear pieces that I never would have (or could have) thought to wear together. Thank you, Alta!

reviews.title: Closet mode
reviews.text: Great app! I would give 5 stars but when I ask to create an outfit on “closet mode,” it only uses items that aren’t even in my “closet.” Maybe I’m doing something wrong? I’m not sure. Other wise the software is so easy to use and I appreciate how it’s free!

reviews.title: Kind of used to be better
reviews.text: I switched to this app pretty much solely because of the avatar generator and the outfit generator. The avatar used to be ok and the outfit generator at least made outfits out of the clothes I have. Now, every avatar looks nothing like the pics I’ve uploaded of myself and every outfit generated includes clothes to be bought despite it being in closet mode.

reviews.title: Love this app but
reviews.text: Always seems like one step forwards two steps back. Why do I get two items of jewelry with each outfit but never any of my 25+ bags?
